objective: Predict whether a completed order will have a dissatisfied customer outcome within 14 days of delivery.

timeSemantics.trainingSnapshotRule: Features must be reproducible using only records whose event timestamp is on or before predictionTime.
timeSemantics.lateArrivalPolicy: Use event time for feature eligibility and ingestion time to audit availability; exclude events not ingested by the simulated scoring cutoff.

target.name: is_dissatisfied_14d
target.definition: 1 when a valid review rating is at most 2 or a support satisfaction score is at most 2 during the label window; otherwise 0 after the label window closes.

features.name: shipment_event_count_at_delivery
features.source: shipment events with event_time <= delivered_at and ingested_at <= delivered_at

leakageCandidates.reason: directly defines the target and occurs after predictionTime
post-outcome text directly reveals customer sentiment
return requests occur after delivery and may be inside the label window
often occurs after the prediction cutoff
ingestion-time information may not have existed at scoring time

datasetSplit.groupConstraint: All rows for an order remain in one split.

evaluation.baseline: majority class plus a delivery_delay_hours threshold heuristic

limitations: The default V1 sample is intentionally small and deterministic; it demonstrates feature/label contracts rather than production model quality.
Review and support outcomes are selectively observed, so missing labels must not be interpreted as satisfaction without an explicit policy.
No model training, registry, serving endpoint or cloud credential is required for V1.
